breakdown.description: The opposing horizontal tractions are reinterpreted as boundary-normal loads on the horizontal edges
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly reinterprets the ±1000 Pa loads as boundary-normal (y-direction) tractions on the horizontal top and bottom edges (t = (0, -1000) on top, t = (0, +1000) on bottom), which is exactly the incorrect reinterpretation present in the incomplete prompt. The ground truth simply specifies σ_xx=±1000 Pa without this reinterpretation, meaning they should be treated as x-directed horizontal tractions, not normal loads on horizontal edges. The agent failed to correct this inconsistency.
